summary: All 21 findings across the three review axes (8 spec, 1 standards, 12 adversarial) are accounted for in the fix round and I independently re-verified the load-bearing ones rather than trusting the fix report's word: re-ran every touched DB battery (19/19 payroll-completeness-witness, 141/141 combined payroll/registry/agreement battery, 23/23 document-capability-registry, 32/32+1 skipped operation-census+rig-isolation), re-ran every touched web unit file (74/74 across payroll-settlements-section/tree/needs-you-affordances/firm-scope-db-pins, matching the report's 9+28+15+22 breakdown exactly), re-ran the whole apps/web unit suite (5187 tests, 5185 pass, 2 known skips -- exact match), re-ran pnpm typecheck (clean) and CI=true GITHUB_ACTIONS=true pnpm lint with FREEZE_BASE_REF=7bc5a710f (exit 0; confirmed the default-base 38-violation freeze failure is pre-existing base drift from origin/main, not this lane -- packages/runtime is untouched by this lane's diff), re-ran check-frozen-evaluators.mjs (OK, 12) and check-frozen-workflows.mjs against the correct base (OK, 322 frozen files, 3 retired), re-ran the payroll-settlement e2e spec on the lane's own Playwright triple (3/3 pass, including the new durable-discovery leg), and live-queried clara_l07 directly (not through the test harness) to confirm the registry is at version 8 across all 240 rows with the corrected basis text naming the completeness witness, the parked question, and the employer-cost residual verbatim as the fix report describes, and confirmed 0342/0343 are both applied. I also read the actual code diffs for the three largest structural fixes (ADV-02's maker-checker draft-and-await-checker arm in 0343, ADV-08's bidirectional compile-time BankTab link in bank-workbench.tsx, and SPEC-01/ADV-03's durable+resumable read module lib/bank/payroll-settlement-reversals.ts) and they match the fix report's description. Nothing above minor remains open beyond what the fix report itself correctly leaves open and labels as such (SPEC-03's payrollFacts_v2 successor ticket, SPEC-05's from-scratch chain, SPEC-08's integration-order watch, and the two follow-ups the fix report explicitly declines to build in-lane: ADV-10's house-wide affordance role gate, and backfilling the two pre-existing needs-you-affordances.test.ts gaps for work_question/accrual_bill_conflict). Accept.
